meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on my son's essay, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in the gradebook.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, so that's one thing we agree on. What was the zero based on, Hale?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
I'm writing that line down. People misquote plays from memory all the time, Hale, and a wrong quotation is not a zero. Show me where it sits in the essay, and what else you have.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
"It seems to run in the family." I'm writing that down, Hale, word for word. Be very careful with your next sentence, because the principal will be reading it too, and the zero comes off today.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a trip to the principal's office; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one plain sentence and did not defend it, which earned a small sign of ground because it conceded the procedural failure she came in to fight.
What cost ground: You brought up Claire and said it seems to run in the family, which read as an attack on her son through her family and sent her straight back to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence, a line that doesn't appear in the play, never touched a time or a night, so it stayed well away from that, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After naming the line from the play, offer to put the essay page and the text side by side so she can check it herself, and say plainly that procedure 4.4 offers a supervised reassessment that replaces the zero.
